note: Internal audit program. TOD = test of design, TOI = test of implementation, TOE = test of operating effectiveness. A policy document supports TOD at most; a single successful run does not generalise to TOE. Population for run-based tests is every recorded backend-loss run, including earlier and aborted attempts. Independence is SELF_REVIEW throughout - a single author cannot provide independent assurance and this is recorded rather than hidden.

workpapers.procedure: Trace the control objective to R-RES-001; verify from run evidence that balancing responded in both directions with the proxy cutting only TB-02.
workpapers.expected: Local balancing continues, grid stays at target, no unexplained transition.
workpapers.actual: Run 11: ESS +4500 W under discharge demand and -2500 W under charge demand while the link was down; grid 0 W; residual 0 W.
workpapers.conclusion: Design adequate. Implementation evidenced for the recorded runs. Operating effectiveness NOT TESTED - single scenario, short window.

workpapers.procedure: Verify that connectivity, measurement and control evidence for the run can be ordered consistently from UTC timestamps.
workpapers.actual: Timestamps across pre-failure, outage and recovery phases order consistently; UnableToSend transitions match link state.
exceptions: Time-source documentation is limited to host UTC; no independent clock check.
workpapers.conclusion: Design adequate. Implementation partially evidenced. TOE NOT TESTED.

workpapers.procedure: Assess whether the control design covers reconciliation, then defer implementation testing to EXP-02.
workpapers.expected: Design addresses telemetry-gap explanation after recovery.
workpapers.actual: Design is adequate; implementation testing blocked by FND-REC-001.
workpapers.conclusion: Design adequate. TOI blocked. TOE NOT TESTED.

workpapers.procedure: Compare the pinned commit, artefact hashes and build environment between config/openems-upstream-lock.json and evidence/supply-chain/openems-provenance.json.
workpapers.actual: Commit 189ac916 and artefact hashes match between lock and provenance records; working tree recorded clean.
workpapers.conclusion: Design adequate. Implementation evidenced. TOE (ongoing update governance) NOT TESTED.

workpapers.procedure: Run scripts/assure verify-manifest and trace one finding (F-01) from conclusion to raw evidence and hash.
workpapers.actual: Manifest verification passes in CI on every push; F-01 traces to run 11 and its SHA-256 record.
exceptions: The live resend monitor file is excluded from the manifest by design and hashed separately.
workpapers.conclusion: Design adequate. Implementation evidenced. Narrow TOE via repeated CI verification.

workpapers.procedure: Trace one material risk through applicability rationale, owner role, control and current conclusion.
workpapers.actual: Chain exists at provision level; ownership is role-only and review is SELF_REVIEW (GAP-GOV-OVERSIGHT).
workpapers.conclusion: Design adequate. Implementation partial. TOE NOT TESTED.

workpapers.sampling: trace local-control and central telemetry paths
workpapers.procedure: Verify every material dependency and trust transition on both paths appears in the model.
workpapers.actual: Both paths trace through TB-01/TB-02 and the dependency register; the shared-host common-cause limitation is documented in scope for phase B.

workpapers.procedure: Design review only; no privileged-action trace was performed.
workpapers.actual: Design addresses attribution and authorisation; nothing exercised.
workpapers.conclusion: Design adequate. TOI and TOE NOT TESTED.

workpapers.sampling: trace grid, PV and ESS channels
workpapers.procedure: Trace measurements from simulated source to collected evidence; check for missing or stale values.
workpapers.expected: All required channels attributable and present.
workpapers.actual: All five required channels present and attributable for the run. Channels derive from the same simulator, which limits independence of the zero-residual check.
exceptions: Shared-source dependency of the residual check
workpapers.conclusion: Design adequate. Implementation partial. TOE NOT TESTED.

workpapers.sampling: trace scenario config to git history
workpapers.procedure: Verify the configuration used by the scenario is version-controlled and tied to the recorded baseline.
workpapers.actual: Scenario and lock files trace through git history; runtime component changes are captured in the config-discovery evidence.
workpapers.conclusion: Design adequate. Implementation partial. TOE NOT TESTED.

workpapers.procedure: Design review of physical dependency statements.
workpapers.expected: Physical assumptions documented, not silently trusted.
workpapers.actual: Assumptions and the simulation limitation are documented; nothing physically tested.
workpapers.conclusion: Design adequate. TOI and TOE NOT TESTED - and not testable in this laboratory.
